lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular matrix; approximately 5 longitudinal rows visible with regular spacing of roughly 6-8 spots per row posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pronounced vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with the primary blobs to form a rectangular grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges running along the upper flank, each defined by a high-luminance superior edge transitioning to a high-contrast shadow inferiorly.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Lower-density distribution of small, high-luminance circular clusters scattered within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily located on the mid-to-lower surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small teleost fish silhouettes (remoras) are visible in close proximity to the ventral-posterior region of the main body.
